title: SB030 · Someone in the water (source scene 23C)
subtitle: Emotion Urgency · two shots, 8 s each · continues from s23-sh02 v2 (same bow, same night) · Ranjith, 2026-11-07

panels.title: His view: a hand and a torch beside the fire
beats: Long lens from the bow toward the burning vallam (centre). 0–2 s it burns; water beside it empty.
2–5 s a hand in a soaked blue camouflage sleeve rises just LEFT of the hull with a small torch; the beam waves twice.
5–6 s the torch goes out; the hand sinks. 6–8 s only the fire and the moving water.

panels.title: Antony shouts to Aashaan (one line)
beats: Start = s23-sh02 v2 last frame (same bow camera); push in to MCU by 2.5 s as he spins round to the deck.
3.0–5.2 s he shouts the line, face just LEFT of the lens (Aashaan at the wheel behind camera).
5.2–8 s silent: breathing hard, he turns back and points at the fire, far LEFT of the stem post.
